text:
Predicates:
Reads(x, y) ::: x reads y.
GainsKnowledge(x) ::: x gains knowledge.
Smarter(x) ::: x becomes smarter.
BookWalden ::: the book "Walden".
AuthorHenry ::: Henry Thoreau is the author of "Walden".
Premises:
Books contain knowledge. ::: (not formalized, assumed as background knowledge)
Reads(harry, BookWalden) ::: Harry read the book “Walden” by Henry Thoreau.
Reads(x, y) → GainsKnowledge(x) ::: When a person reads a book, that person gains knowledge.
GainsKnowledge(x) → Smarter(x) ::: If a person gains knowledge, they become smarter.
Conclusion:
Smarter(harry) ::: Harry is smarter than before.
